ValidationRule.description: Requires Amount > 0 once an Opportunity reaches Proposal Presented or any later commit stage. Early pipeline and Closed Lost are exempt; System Administrator is exempt. Source: forensic audit OPP-DQ-02 / M8-5.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Proposal Presented"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Contract Sent"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Financing Review"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Contract Signed"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Deposit Paid"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Pre-Production"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "In Progress"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Pre Close"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Job Completed") ), OR(ISBLANK(Amount), Amount <= 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Amount must be greater than $0 once this Opportunity reaches Proposal Presented or later. Add the deal amount before saving.
